abstract: A radioligand receptor assay system for urinary hCG and serum hCG was developed, using 1100-2000 times g fractions of homogenates of pig testis. This method is specific for hCG and LH, and the limit of detection for hCG was 20 mIU, which could be significantly discriminated from zero at the 95% confidence level. A nonspecific inhibition reaction which exerts its influence on the assay system has been found in the urine and serum, and in performing assays for urinary and serum hCG, it was necessary to remove the inhibition reaction by diluting the urine more than eight fold or subject the serum to an extraction procedure. Since the hCG of normal pregnancy and trophoblastic neoplasia showed a dose response curve similar to that of the International Standard hCG, it became clear that these hCG could be assayed with this method. The potency ratio R/I measured by RRA and RIA of urinary hCG and serum hCG was different from those of normal pregnancy and trophoblastic neoplasia.
abstract_ja: ブタ精巣の1100～2000×g分画のホモジネートを用い、尿中および血清のヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)に対するラジオリガンド受容体測定系を開発した。本法はhCGとLHに特異的で、hCGの検出限界は20 mIUであり、これは95%信頼水準でゼロと有意に区別できた。尿および血清中には測定系に影響を及ぼす非特異的阻害反応が認められ、尿中hCGの測定では尿を8倍以上希釈し、血清では抽出操作を行うことで阻害反応を除去する必要があった。正常妊娠および絨毛性腫瘍のhCGは国際標準hCGと類似の用量反応曲線を示したことから、これらのhCGも本法で測定可能であることが明らかになった。RRAとRIAで測定した尿中および血清hCGの効力比R/Iは、正常妊娠と絨毛性腫瘍とで異なっていた。
